# Release Notes

## 0.42.0 - 2026-10-20 (deployed)

Environment: production. Deployed SHA `7cd6cdd397420478c0fbd14ce9d9d9351a550039`, run `39433327350`. MINOR: new backwards-compatible partner payment reporting capability.

Partner payment reporting adds inclusive Payment.paid_at date filters, daily/weekly/monthly grouping, repeat and renewal payment events, exact currency-separated totals, and durable first-touch registration attribution. The finance-admin report is permission-gated and supports manual partner settlement only; no commissions or automatic payouts are introduced.

Verification: exact-SHA validation 39432251347 and approved production deployment 39433327350 succeeded; production revision/readiness readback passed at 2026-10-20T16:14:35.509685+00:00.
